# Comments of a dictionary's orders (sp_ModifyIndexProperty COMMENT) short and
# long, changed, and what the original frees of them when the order or its table is
# dropped: the dictionary, de/de.add, is kept in fixtures/sql/spddidxcomment/:
#
#     run.sh <work> <ace32.dll> spddidxcomment.txt > ../../../fixtures/sql/spddidxcomment.json
#     cp <work>/data/de/de.a* ../../../fixtures/sql/spddidxcomment/
ddcreate de\de.add
stmt
direct CREATE TABLE t1 (id INTEGER, a CHAR(4), b CHAR(4), c CHAR(4))
direct CREATE INDEX i1 ON t1 (id)
direct CREATE INDEX i2 ON t1 (a)
direct CREATE INDEX i3 ON t1 (b)
direct CREATE INDEX i4 ON t1 (c)
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyIndexProperty('t1', 'i1', 'COMMENT', 'short comment')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyIndexProperty('t1', 'i2', 'COMMENT', '')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyIndexProperty('t1', 'i3', 'COMMENT', '')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyIndexProperty('t1', 'i4', 'COMMENT', 'another short one')
direct CREATE TABLE u1 (x INTEGER)
direct CREATE TABLE u2 (x INTEGER)
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyIndexProperty('t1', 'i1', 'COMMENT', '')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyIndexProperty('t1', 'i2', 'COMMENT', 'now short')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyIndexProperty('t1', 'i3', 'COMMENT', 'eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyIndexProperty('t1', 'i4', 'COMMENT', '')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyIndexProperty('t1', 'i2', 'COMMENT', '')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyIndexProperty('t1', 'i2', 'COMMENT', '')
direct CREATE TABLE u3 (x INTEGER)
direct DROP INDEX t1.i1
direct CREATE TABLE u4 (x INTEGER)
direct DROP INDEX t1.i2
direct DROP INDEX t1.i3
direct DROP INDEX t1.i4
direct CREATE TABLE u5 (x INTEGER)
direct CREATE TABLE t2 (id INTEGER, a CHAR(4), b CHAR(4))
direct CREATE INDEX j1 ON t2 (id)
direct CREATE INDEX j2 ON t2 (a)
direct CREATE INDEX j3 ON t2 (b)
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyIndexProperty('t2', 'j1', 'COMMENT', '')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyIndexProperty('t2', 'j2', 'COMMENT', 'short')
direct EXECUTE PROCEDURE sp_ModifyIndexProperty('t2', 'j3', 'COMMENT', '')
direct CREATE TABLE u6 (x INTEGER)
direct DROP TABLE t2
direct CREATE TABLE u7 (x INTEGER)
query SELECT * FROM system.indexes
